title: Location Intelligence Software | Location Analytics Software
content:
### What is location intelligence?

Location intelligence is the process of analyzing location-based data to generate actionable insights. Often delivered through location intelligence software, it combines geographic, demographic, and behavioral data to support location-based decisions.

At Kalibrate, we live and breath location intelligence and have developed our own industry-leading software, enabling our customers to benefit from powerful insights.

### How does data visualization, analytics, and reporting work in the software?

Kalibrate Location Intelligence allows users to view, edit, and add any first party data related to your customers, locations, or competitors. Users can run demographic and competitor reports and  create sales forecast reports using models that are developed and integrated for use.

In addition, users can visualize thematic maps, view and report on customer loyalty data, and view and report on mobile/foot traffic data. The platform supports bulk reporting/mapping and has an API for an ongoing transfer of data.

### How does Kalibrate’s pricing work?

The pricing of Kalibrate Location Intelligence is driven by a few factors: the amount of third-party data you want to license, the number of users/seats your team needs, and if you want to include analytics into the platform.

### Can data be imported directly into the platform?

Data can be imported in two ways:

1\. End user drag and drop: Microsoft Excel data can be dragged and dropped into the software. As part of this process, data can be automatically geocoded. Once the data is on the map it can be shared with other people in the organization.

2\. A secure API can be set up for ongoing uploading and downloading of data.

### Which teams or departments can use Kalibrate Location Intelligence?

The Kalibrate Location Intelligence software is designed to scale with your business. Departments that use the tool include but are not limited to: real estate, construction, marketing, finance, executives, store operations, and HR.

### What is geospatial data?

Geospatial data is information that links to a specific physical location, describing objects or events by their location and attributes. It helps visualize and analyze where things happen, like tracking a moving car or mapping a building, revealing patterns and insights using maps and spatial tools.

Kalibrate Location Intelligence software uses geospatial data to generate valuable insights.

### Does the platform have mobile capabilities?

Yes, Kalibrate Location Intelligence is available as a fully native iOS and Android application. The mobile app gives users the same access to data and reporting as the desktop version, but in an interface that is designed to be touch friendly.

The app is designed to give you access in the field and serves as an excellent tool for capturing data such as store signage, store photos, competitor data, and other notes from the field. Site Tours planned in the desktop version of KLI can be executed in the mobile app.

### What support is provided?

Kalibrate provides clients with a dedicated customer success manager that will engage with you during implementation of the platform and beyond. Your customer success manager will get to know your business goals to make sure you’re getting the most from the software.

There is a monthly virtual training session where all Kalibrate clients can join to learn about new features and tools, hear how other clients are utilizing the software, and is an open forum for questions.

### Can Kalibrate Location Intelligence benefit restaurants?

Yes, Kalibrate Location Intelligence software has been used by many brands within the [restaurant sector](https://kalibrate.com/industries/restaurant/), such as Five Guys, Papa Johns, and Jersey Mike’s, to help fuel business growth through valuable data-driven insights.

### Can Kalibrate Location Intelligence be used by retail?

The retail industry has evolved significantly in recent years as retailers adapt to a more online landscape. This means it’s more important than ever to ensure retailers make good business decisions which enable your business to enter new markets.

We have helped established brands such as Home Depot and TJX identify new store locations to grow their retail network.

### Can Kalibrate Location Intelligence be used in the fuel sector?

Like many retail sectors in the digital age, fuel retail is evolving fast. Therefore, it’s vital to maximize site potential, while understanding consumer behavior and competitor activity. This is where Kalibrate Location Intelligence software can help you secure a competitive advantage. Relying on intuition is no longer enough to keep pace and maximize business growth in the fuel sector. The data which we’re able to generate holds the key to transforming your network strategy and has been trusted by brands such as Rompetrol, Tri Star Energy and Preem.
